research_rationale: The complete four-section original in ORIGINAL:EO:11860 was read with full ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11948 and its operative revocation and effective-date provisions. Inventory corrections restore sections 3 and 4 obscured by OCR segmentation. Section 2 is an affirmative lead requiring scrutiny of earlier work completion, but its one-year performance deadline is not a self-executing termination provision. Formal revocation is effective 1976-12-31 under actor sections 4(a)(3) and 5. Because the held record does not fix possible earlier completion of mission functions, this sheet is unable rather than claiming the later formal revocation as every clause first end. The adequate OFR search covers the 1975 order, its later-event chain and saved order texts; eCFR reaches the cutoff, while the U.S. Code search with a five-day cutoff lag is not selected. No other affirmative earlier-ending or independent residual lead appears.
